reasons: Within safe holding window: 150 minutes remaining (base 3.5h).

Evaluated surplus with 2 dish(es) under ambient conditions. Based on guidance in [cooked_rice_safety_2], [dairy_and_curd_safety_2], holding window is active until 15:00. Mandatory temperature check recommended prior to handover.

messages.en: TickTock Meals: Urgent food rescue! 75 portions Steamed Sona Masoori Rice, Vegetable Drumstick Sambar (Pure Veg). Allergens: nuts (visual guess only). Safe until: 03:00 PM. Pickup Area: Yelahanka New Town. Reply ACCEPT to claim or DECLINE.
messages.kn: ಟಿಕ್‌ಟಾಕ್ ಮೀಲ್ಸ್: ತುರ್ತು ಆಹಾರ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ! 75 ಊಟ Steamed Sona Masoori Rice, Vegetable Drumstick Sambar (ಶುದ್ಧ ಸಸ್ಯಾಹಾರಿ). ಅಲರ್ಜಿನ್: nuts (ದೃಶ್ಯ ಅಂದಾಜು ಮಾತ್ರ). ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ ಸಮಯ: 03:00 PM. ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣಾ ಪ್ರದೇಶ: ಯಲಹಂಕ. ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಲು ACCEPT ಅಥವಾ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಲು DECLINE ಎಂದು ಉತ್ತರಿಸಿ.
